events.title: MTV turns 45
events.blurb: Music Television (MTV) launched on August 1, 1981, with The Buggles' 'Video Killed The Radio Star' as its first music video.

angles.name: MTV Memories
angles.copy: Remember the early days of MTV? Today marks 45 years since the channel launched, changing music forever. What was the first music video that truly blew your mind? #MTVLives

events.title: Woodstock Festival began 57 years ago
events.blurb: The iconic Woodstock Music & Art Fair, a pivotal moment in music history, began on August 15, 1969, in Bethel, New York.

angles.name: Peace, Love & Music
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years ago, half a million people gathered for three days of peace, love, and music. The legendary Woodstock Festival began today in '69. Which classic act would you have loved to see live?

events.title: Remembering Elvis Presley
events.blurb: Elvis Presley, the 'King of Rock and Roll', passed away on August 16, 1977, at the age of 42.

angles.name: The King's Legacy
angles.copy: Today marks the anniversary of the passing of Elvis Presley, who left us far too soon at just 42. His music continues to inspire generations. What's your all-time favourite Elvis track? #TheKing

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, the American-British singer, songwriter, and founding member of The Pretenders, was born on September 7, 1951.

angles.name: Pretenders Icon
angles.copy: Happy 75th birthday to the iconic Chrissie Hynde! The voice and force behind The Pretenders, still rocking after all these years. What's your favourite Pretenders hit?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Liam Gallagher, the English singer-songwriter and former frontman of Oasis, was born on September 21, 1972.

angles.name: Rock 'n' Roll Star Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 54th birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! The voice of a generation, still bringing that swagger. What's your top Oasis or solo track? #LiamGallagher

events.title: Happy James Bond Day!
events.blurb: October 5th marks James Bond Day, celebrating the release of the first Bond film, 'Dr. No', on this day in 1962.

angles.name: Shaken, Not Stirred
angles.copy: It's James Bond Day! Celebrating 007 and over six decades of espionage, gadgets, and iconic theme tunes. What's your favourite Bond film or song? #JamesBondDay

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: John Lennon, the English singer-songwriter and co-founder of The Beatles, was born on October 9, 1940.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: Today, we remember John Lennon, who would have been 86. His timeless music and message of peace continue to resonate globally. What's your favourite Lennon song?

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: English actor, comedian, and writer John Cleese, best known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, was born on October 27, 1939.

angles.name: Comedy Legend's Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the legendary John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, he's given us endless laughs. What's your favourite John Cleese moment?
